messages.subject: Problem running 'modelBasedQCPlots' with MSstats version 3.0.7
parts:
Hi MSstats,

I'm trying to run the 'modelBasedQCPlots' command, but it's not working. Please take a look below and let me know if you can help me get this to work.

Sincerely,

Scott Goulding


The commands and the order I'm running them are identical to this example on GitHub: https://github.com/MeenaChoi/MSstats_material/blob/master/example%20dataset/SRM_rat/Rscript_SRM_rat.R

If I run the 'modelBasedQCPlots' command before running the 'groupComparison' command (like the GitHub example) I get the following errors:

> modelBasedQCPlots(data=quantData$ModelQC,type="QQPlots",feature.QQPlot="byFeature")

Error in data[data$PROTEIN == levels(data$PROTEIN)[i], ] : 
  incorrect number of dimensions
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In is.na(data$fitted) :
  is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'NULL'
2: In is.na(data$residuals) :
  is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'NULL'

> modelBasedQCPlots(data=quantData$ModelQC,type="QQPlots")

Error in data[data$PROTEIN == levels(data$PROTEIN)[i], ] : 
  incorrect number of dimensions
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In is.na(data$fitted) :
  is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'NULL'
2: In is.na(data$residuals) :
  is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'NULL'

> modelBasedQCPlots(data=quantData$ModelQC,type="ResidualPlots")

Error in data[data$PROTEIN == levels(data$PROTEIN)[i], ] : 
  incorrect number of dimensions
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In is.na(data$fitted) :
  is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'NULL'
2: In is.na(data$residuals) :
  is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'NULL'
3: In min(data$residuals, na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf
4: In max(data$residuals, na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
5: In min(data$fitted, na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf
6: In max(data$fitted, na.rm = TRUE) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf


However, if I run the 'modelBasedQCPlots' command after running the 'groupComparison' command (different from the GitHub example) I get the following errors:

> modelBasedQCPlots(data=resultComparison$ModelQC,type="ResidualPlots")

Error in `$<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, "PEPTIDE", value = integer(0)) : 
  replacement has 0 rows, data has 46

> modelBasedQCPlots(data=resultComparison$ModelQC,type="QQPlots",feature.QQPlot="byFeature")

Nothing happens...

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Problem running 'modelBasedQCPlots' with MSstats version 3.0.7
parts:
Hi Scott,

First of all, now modelBasedQCPlots command should work with dataProcess output.
and R script you mentioned works in my side. I got the QQ plot and residual plot(attached) based on the R script (Rscript_SRM_rat.R).

I guess that you probably use different option in dataProcess step. Now 'modelBasedQCPlots' only works for summaryMethod="linear" and censoredInt=NULL.

If not, please let me know.

-Meena

messages.subject: Re: Problem running 'modelBasedQCPlots' with MSstats version 3.0.7
parts:

I'm using "censoredInt=0," so that's the issue.
